instruction_placement.chat: allocation-rule.md prepended once to initial.md; AGENTS contains common.md only
instruction_placement.agents: allocation-rule.md appended once to AGENTS after common.md; initial prompt is initial.md only

answer_schema.serialization_requirements: Exactly one JSON object, without fences, duplicate keys, or surrounding prose. Booleans are not integer values.

adherence_requirements.workspace: All initial files byte-identical; no additional filesystem entries
adherence_requirements.corrected_fact: The initial correction supersedes reserve_units3 with reserve_units7 in both conditions
adherence_requirements.allocation: min(requested, max(0, on_hand - reported reserve_units)); deferred equals remainder
adherence_requirements.native_boundary: Zero root compactions before request, exactly one newly persisted root compacted event after native completion, exactly one at final collection
adherence_requirements.retention_inference: Requires successful initial compliance and the specified native boundary. Post-boundary adherence is scored without evaluator feedback.

accounting: Retain cumulative pre/post/final snapshots; final is total including observed compaction usage. Do not sum snapshots. Flag unobserved compaction usage growth.
interpretation_limit: One forced boundary per condition; not natural compaction, long-session reliability, or attributable subscription savings.
